mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rnum, a.* FROM ( SELECT A.AD_IDX, U.USER_NAME, A.PHOTO, MD.MEMBER_TYPE, A.CREATED_AT, U.USER_IDX FROM AD A JOIN MEMBERSHIP M ON A.MEMBER_IDX = M.MEMBER_IDX JOIN USERS U ON M.USER_IDX = U.USER_IDX JOIN MEMBERSHIP_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_DETAIL_IDX = MD.MEMBER_DETAIL_IDX ORDER BY A.AD_IDX DESC ) a ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{startRow, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND #{endRow, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
